\section{Waves}
\subsection{Basics}
\begin{frame}{Wave Speed}
  A wave of wavelength $\lambda$ and frequency $f$ travels at
  \begin{equation*}
    v = \lambda f .
  \end{equation*}
  The wave number is $k = 2\pi/\lambda$.
\end{frame}

\section{Superposition}
\subsection{Beats}
\begin{frame}{Beat Frequency}
  \begin{itemize}
    \item Two tones with frequencies $f_1$ and $f_2$ are added.
    \item The beat frequency is $f_b = |f_1 - f_2|$.
  \end{itemize}
  \begin{align*}
    \cos a + \cos b &= 2 \cos\frac{a+b}{2} \cos\frac{a-b}{2}.
  \end{align*}
\end{frame}
